faqs.q: Won't my TRS pension be enough?
faqs.a: For many Texas teachers, TRS replaces only part of your paycheck — and inflation, healthcare, and taxes squeeze it further. The review shows your real number so you can see the gap clearly.

faqs.q: Is this a sales pitch for a product?
faqs.a: No. We start with a Financial Certainty Review to find the gaps and map a plan. Any strategy is built around your TRS benefits and your life — never a cookie-cutter product.

faqs.q: What exactly is the Financial Certainty Review?
faqs.a: A one-on-one deep dive that maps your TRS estimate, savings, and spending to show where you stand today, what could derail the plan, and a clear path to tax-smart income.
Strategies designed so the income you draw in retirement isn't eroded by taxes the way traditional withdrawals can be — used to supplement TRS and help close your gap.

faqs.q: I'm close to retirement — is it too late?
faqs.a: Often, no. Many teachers 8–15 years out (and even closer) can still meaningfully close the gap with the right plan. The review tells you what's realistic for your timeline.

faqs.q: How much does the review cost?
faqs.a: Your initial Financial Certainty Review is free, with no obligation.
